pr.body:
## Why

Implements the OpenSpec change `add-opt-in-telemetry` (merged in #61, designed via three adversarially-reviewed rounds). v1.16.0 is JUST telemetry: roadmap decisions stop being guesses, and an automated canary catches fleet-wide regressions before bug reports arrive.

## What

**Plugin (C#)**
- `TelemetryData` persisted inside PluginConfiguration: opt-in flag (default off), random regenerable instance UUID (generated server-side at opt-in), window counters + per-category error states that survive restarts, ping timestamps, jitter slot.
- `TelemetryService`: error classification from the real failure-message patterns, rising-edge transition detection with 1/day cap + queue-and-consolidate, week-rollover send gate, bucketed anonymous payload builder (no IPs/usernames/titles/raw counts, enforced by test).
- `TelemetryTask`: daily scheduled task; weekly ping when the UTC week rolls + jitter passes; drains queued transition pings.
- Hooks: SyncHistory.Record chokepoint + auth-failure catches in all three runners + Jellyseerr batch failures.
- Admin-only `GET /Telemetry/Preview`; Settings section (checkbox, Regenerate ID, Preview exact JSON modal doubling as diagnostic bundle with deanonymization warning); one-time dismissible opt-in banner on the dashboard tab.
- 39 new tests; full suite 566 passed / 11 skipped.

**Backend (checked in as `worker/`, deploys to Cloudflare Workers + D1 — swapped from Supabase after its Pro pricing came in at ~$45/mo; D1 is free at this scale and never idle-pauses)**
- `worker/schema.sql`: pings table, partial unique weekly (instance, week) index, latest_per_instance view. No client-facing DB access path at all.
- `worker/src/index.ts`: sole write path — ingest key check, shape validation, 2 KB cap, transient per-IP + global rate limits (IPs never persisted), server-computed UTC week, counter-MERGING weekly upsert, per-instance daily transition cap (204 on hit).

**Workflow**
- `telemetry-canary.yml`: daily deterministic D1 SQL check — release-age-band pooled cohorts, Sybil gate (≥2 weeks history), n ≥ 10 + 3x gates, deduped evidence-backed issues, row-growth abuse alarm, loud failure on unreachable DB, and self-sustains against GitHub's 60-day cron auto-disable. (The separate keepalive workflow died with the Supabase pause problem.)

## Provisioned and verified

- [x] D1 database created (Oceania), schema applied, Worker deployed at lbsync-telemetry.lachlanbyoung.workers.dev, `TelemetryConstants` wired to the live endpoint
- [x] 8-case curl acceptance matrix all green (201/200-merge/201/204-cap/401/400/413/405); duplicate-week counter MERGE verified against the live database; synthetic test rows deleted
- [x] Deployed to the maintainer's own server (Jellyfin 10.11.10): loads clean, opt-in flow exercised end-to-end, instance ID generated
- [x] Banner copy approved live on the maintainer's own dashboard
- [ ] Post-merge: set `TELEMETRY_CF_API_TOKEN` repo secret for the canary workflow (account-ID half already set); canary fails loudly until then

## Release notes

New: anonymous, opt-in usage telemetry — off by default, enabled via a one-time dashboard banner or Settings. One small bucketed ping a week (versions, enabled features, size buckets; never film titles, usernames, IPs, or exact numbers), a Preview-exact-JSON button showing precisely what's sent, a regenerable random instance ID, and an extra capped ping when errors start occurring so fleet-wide breakage is caught early. Full payload documented in the README. No other behaviour changes.

@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+name: Telemetry canary
+
+# Daily deterministic regression check over the telemetry fleet — no AI in the loop,
+# so every filed issue is reproducible and arguable. Spec:
+# openspec/changes/add-opt-in-telemetry/specs/fleet-canary/spec.md
+#
+# Backend is Cloudflare D1 (never pauses, so no DB keep-alive exists); queries run
+# through wrangler with a scoped API token. This workflow still keeps ITSELF alive:
+# GitHub disables cron workflows after 60 days without repo activity, so when repo
+# activity is older than 50 days a heartbeat timestamp is committed to a dedicated
+# non-main branch (never main, where the every-merge-ships pipeline would cut a junk
+# release or go red on the version gate).
+#
+# Definitions (all tunable below):
+#   active     = instance with a weekly ping in the trailing 14 days
+#   eligible   = instance with >= 2 distinct weekly-ping weeks (Sybil gate)
+#   foreground = versions released in the trailing 14 days (from manifest.json), pooled
+#   baseline   = everything older, pooled, excluding versions referenced by a
+#                still-open canary issue (an unfixed regression can't mask itself)
+#   cohort     = an instance belongs to the version of its most recent ping of ANY type
+#   rate       = eligible instances with an error-transition ping in the trailing 7 days
+#                / active eligible instances in the cohort
+# Issue gate: both cohorts n >= MIN_N and foreground rate >= RATE_MULTIPLE x baseline.
+# Dedup: open issue labelled telemetry-canary matching (suspect version, category).
+# The same run doubles as the row-growth abuse alarm, and any run that cannot reach
+# the database fails loudly.
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "47 17 * * *" # daily, 17:47 UTC
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  issues: write
+
+env:
+  MIN_N: 10
+  RATE_MULTIPLE: 3
+  MAX_TOTAL_ROWS: 1000000
+  MAX_NEW_INSTANCES_PER_DAY: 500
+  D1_DB: lbsync-telemetry
+
+jobs:
+  canary:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+
+      - name: Run checks
+        env:
+          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TELEMETRY_CF_API_TOKEN }}
+          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEMETRY_CF_ACCOUNT_ID }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        working-directory: worker
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ] || [ -z "$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID" ]; then
+            echo "::error::TELEMETRY_CF_API_TOKEN / TELEMETRY_CF_ACCOUNT_ID secrets not configured."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          d1() { npx --yes wrangler d1 execute "$D1_DB" --remote --json --command "$1"; }
+
+          # ---- Reachability + growth alarm (abuse detection; loud failure) ----
+          GROWTH=$(d1 "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pings) AS total_rows,
+                              (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) FROM pings
+                               WHERE received_at > datetime('now','-1 day')
+                                 AND instance_id NOT IN (
+                                   SELECT DISTINCT instance_id FROM pings
+                                   WHERE received_at <= datetime('now','-1 day'))) AS new_instances;")
+          TOTAL_ROWS=$(echo "$GROWTH" | jq '.[0].results[0].total_rows')
+          NEW_INSTANCES=$(echo "$GROWTH" | jq '.[0].results[0].new_instances')
+          echo "Total rows: $TOTAL_ROWS; new instances last 24h: $NEW_INSTANCES"
+          if [ "$TOTAL_ROWS" -gt "$MAX_TOTAL_ROWS" ] || [ "$NEW_INSTANCES" -gt "$MAX_NEW_INSTANCES_PER_DAY" ]; then
+            echo "::error::Telemetry growth alarm: rows=$TOTAL_ROWS new_instances_24h=$NEW_INSTANCES exceed bounds."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # ---- Foreground versions: released in the trailing 14 days, per manifest ----
+          CUTOFF=$(date -u -d '14 days ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
+          FOREGROUND=$(jq -r --arg cutoff "$CUTOFF" \
+            '.[0].versions[] | select(.timestamp > $cutoff) | .version' ../manifest.json | sort -u)
+          if [ -z "$FOREGROUND" ]; then
+            echo "No versions released in the trailing 14 days; canary is structurally silent today."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          FG_SQL=$(echo "$FOREGROUND" | sed "s/.*/'&'/" | paste -sd, -)
+          echo "Foreground versions: $(echo "$FOREGROUND" | paste -sd' ' -)"
+
+          # ---- Baseline exclusions: versions named in open canary issues ----
+          EXCLUDED=$(gh issue list --label telemetry-canary --state open --json title \
+            --jq '.[].title | capture("v(?<v>[0-9.]+)").v' 2>/dev/null | sort -u || true)
+          EX_SQL="''"
+          [ -n "$EXCLUDED" ] && EX_SQL=$(echo "$EXCLUDED" | sed "s/.*/'&'/" | paste -sd, -)
+          echo "Baseline exclusions: ${EXCLUDED:-none}"
+
+          COHORT_CTE="
+            WITH eligible AS (
+              SELECT instance_id FROM pings WHERE ping_type='weekly'
+              GROUP BY instance_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT week) >= 2
+            ),
+            active AS (
+              SELECT DISTINCT instance_id FROM pings
+              WHERE ping_type='weekly' AND received_at > datetime('now','-14 days')
+            ),
+            cohort AS (
+              SELECT p.instance_id, p.plugin_version FROM pings p
+              JOIN eligible USING (instance_id) JOIN active USING (instance_id)
+              WHERE p.received_at = (SELECT MAX(p2.received_at) FROM pings p2 WHERE p2.instance_id = p.instance_id)
+            ),
+            grouped AS (
+              SELECT instance_id,
+                     CASE WHEN plugin_version IN ($FG_SQL) THEN 'fg'
+                          WHEN plugin_version IN ($EX_SQL) THEN 'excluded'
+                          ELSE 'bg' END AS pool
+              FROM cohort
+            ),
+            tr AS (
+              SELECT DISTINCT t.instance_id, cat.category,
+                     CASE WHEN t.plugin_version IN ($FG_SQL) THEN 'fg'
+                          WHEN t.plugin_version IN ($EX_SQL) THEN 'excluded'
+                          ELSE 'bg' END AS pool,
+                     t.plugin_version
+              FROM pings t
+              JOIN eligible e ON e.instance_id = t.instance_id
+              CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'cloudflare_403' AS category UNION SELECT 'auth_failure'
+                          UNION SELECT 'tmdb_lookup' UNION SELECT 'jellyseerr_error' UNION SELECT 'other') cat
+              WHERE t.ping_type='error_transition'
+                AND t.received_at > datetime('now','-7 days')
+                AND json_extract(t.errors, '\$.state.' || cat.category) = 1
+            )"
+
+          POOLS=$(d1 "$COHORT_CTE SELECT pool, COUNT(*) AS n FROM grouped GROUP BY pool;")
+          FG_N=$(echo "$POOLS" | jq '[.[0].results[] | select(.pool=="fg") | .n] | first // 0')
+          BG_N=$(echo "$POOLS" | jq '[.[0].results[] | select(.pool=="bg") | .n] | first // 0')
+          if [ "$FG_N" -lt "$MIN_N" ] || [ "$BG_N" -lt "$MIN_N" ]; then
+            echo "Below n gate (fg=$FG_N, bg=$BG_N, need >= $MIN_N each). Silence is correct behaviour."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+
+          HITS=$(d1 "$COHORT_CTE SELECT category, pool, plugin_version, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) AS c FROM tr GROUP BY category, pool, plugin_version;")
+
+          for CAT in cloudflare_403 auth_failure tmdb_lookup jellyseerr_error other; do
+            FG_HITS=$(echo "$HITS" | jq --arg c "$CAT" '[.[0].results[] | select(.category==$c and .pool=="fg") | .c] | add // 0')
+            BG_HITS=$(echo "$HITS" | jq --arg c "$CAT" '[.[0].results[] | select(.category==$c and .pool=="bg") | .c] | add // 0')
+            [ "$FG_HITS" -eq 0 ] && continue
+            # Half-instance floor on the baseline avoids divide-by-zero while still
+            # requiring a real foreground signal (>= 3 affected instances).
+            TRIPPED=$(jq -n --argjson fh "$FG_HITS" --argjson bh "$BG_HITS" \
+              --argjson fn "$FG_N" --argjson bn "$BG_N" --argjson mult "$RATE_MULTIPLE" \
+              '(($fh / $fn) / (([$bh, 0.5] | max) / $bn)) >= $mult and $fh >= 3')
+            [ "$TRIPPED" != "true" ] && continue
+
+            SUSPECT=$(echo "$HITS" | jq -r --arg c "$CAT" '[.[0].results[] | select(.category==$c and .pool=="fg")] | max_by(.c) | .plugin_version')
+            TITLE="Telemetry canary: $CAT regression in v$SUSPECT"
+
+            if gh issue list --label telemetry-canary --state open --search "\"$TITLE\" in:title" --json number --jq 'length' | grep -qv '^0$'; then
+              echo "Dedup: open issue already exists for ($SUSPECT, $CAT)."
+              continue
+            fi
+
+            EVIDENCE=$(echo "$HITS" | jq -r --arg c "$CAT" '[.[0].results[] | select(.category==$c and .pool=="fg")] | map("| \(.plugin_version) | \(.c) |") | join("\n")')
+            gh issue create --label telemetry-canary \
+              --title "$TITLE" \
+              --body "$(printf 'Automated fleet-canary finding. No AI involved; the queries in .github/workflows/telemetry-canary.yml reproduce it.\n\n**Category:** %s\n**Foreground** (versions released in trailing 14 days, pooled): %s of %s active eligible instances hit a %s error-transition in the trailing 7 days.\n**Baseline** (older versions pooled, exclusions applied): %s of %s.\n\n**Per-version evidence (foreground):**\n\n| version | instances |\n|---|---|\n%s\n\nThresholds: n >= %s both cohorts, rate multiple >= %sx.\n' "$CAT" "$FG_HITS" "$FG_N" "$CAT" "$BG_HITS" "$BG_N" "$EVIDENCE" "$MIN_N" "$RATE_MULTIPLE")"
+            echo "Filed: $TITLE"
+          done
+
+      - name: Self-sustain against GitHub's 60-day cron auto-disable
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          git fetch origin 'refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*' --quiet
+          NEWEST=$(git for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(committerdate:unix)' refs/remotes/origin | head -1)
+          AGE_DAYS=$(( ( $(date +%s) - NEWEST ) / 86400 ))
+          echo "Most recent repo activity: ${AGE_DAYS} day(s) ago."
+          if [ "$AGE_DAYS" -lt 50 ]; then
+            echo "No heartbeat needed."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          git config user.name "telemetry-canary"
+          git config user.email "actions@github.com"
+          git checkout -B telemetry-heartbeat origin/telemetry-heartbeat 2>/dev/null || git checkout --orphan telemetry-heartbeat
+          git rm -rf --cached . 2>/dev/null || true
+          date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > heartbeat.txt
+          git add heartbeat.txt
+          git commit -m "telemetry canary heartbeat"
+          git push origin telemetry-heartbeat
+          echo "Heartbeat committed to telemetry-heartbeat branch."

+## Telemetry
+
+The plugin can send **anonymous, opt-in** usage telemetry. It is **off by default** — nothing is ever sent unless you enable it (one-time dashboard banner or the Settings checkbox).
+
+When enabled, one small ping is sent per week, plus one extra ping (capped at one per day) when sync errors start occurring so fleet-wide breakage gets caught early. The full payload is exactly this — you can see your own at any time via **Settings → Anonymous Telemetry → Preview exact JSON**:
+
+```json
+{
+  "schema_version": 1,
+  "instance_id": "8a6f4f6e-1f2b-4c43-9a57-2f0e6f3b9d1c",
+  "ping_type": "weekly",
+  "plugin_version": "1.16.0.0",
+  "jellyfin_version": "10.11.11",
+  "features": { "watchlist_sync": true, "diary_import": false, "...": "booleans of which settings are enabled" },
+  "buckets": { "accounts": "1", "library": "2k-10k", "syncs_per_week": "1-10" },
+  "errors": { "cloudflare_403": 0, "auth_failure": 0, "tmdb_lookup": 0, "jellyseerr_error": 0, "other": 0,
+              "state": { "cloudflare_403": false, "...": "which error types are currently occurring" } }
+}
+```
+
+The precise promise, worded carefully:
+
+- **No IPs, usernames, film titles, library content, or exact counts ever enter the dataset.** Counts are reported in buckets only. (Transport logs at the hosting platform retain caller IPs for the platform's own short retention window, like any HTTPS service; they are never stored in the telemetry dataset.)
+- The instance ID is **random**, generated when you opt in, never derived from your hardware, network, or Jellyfin install. **Regenerate it any time** in Settings: future pings get a fresh identity. Old rows remain (unlinked going forward); at small fleet sizes configuration similarity could in principle still allow correlation, so the honest claim is "unlinked", not "erased".
+- The "Preview exact JSON" modal doubles as a **diagnostic bundle** for bug reports. It contains your instance ID — pasting it into a public issue links that ID to your past pings, which is why the modal offers **Copy + regenerate ID**.
+- Disabling telemetry stops all pings immediately.
+
+What it's for: deciding what gets built next based on what people actually use, and an automated canary that compares error rates across releases and files regression issues before bug reports arrive.
+

+-- Telemetry storage on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite). The database is reachable ONLY
+-- through the ingest Worker and scoped API tokens; there is no direct client
+-- access path, which is what RLS provided in the abandoned Supabase design.
+-- See openspec/changes/add-opt-in-telemetry/specs/telemetry-backend.
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pings (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+    received_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),
+    -- Computed by the Worker from UTC arrival time (client clocks drift).
+    week TEXT NOT NULL,
+    instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    plugin_version TEXT NOT NULL,
+    jellyfin_version TEXT NOT NULL,
+    ping_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ping_type IN ('weekly', 'error_transition')),
+    features TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+    buckets TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+    errors TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
+);
+
+-- One weekly row per instance per week; the Worker merges counters on conflict
+-- so a duplicate send can never destroy a window's counts.
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_weekly_instance_week
+    ON pings (instance_id, week) WHERE ping_type = 'weekly';
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_instance_received ON pings (instance_id, received_at DESC);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_type_received ON pings (ping_type, received_at DESC);
+
+-- Active installs by version: latest weekly ping per instance.
+CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS latest_per_instance AS
+SELECT p.instance_id, p.received_at, p.week, p.plugin_version, p.jellyfin_version,
+       p.features, p.buckets, p.errors
+FROM pings p
+JOIN (
+    SELECT instance_id, MAX(received_at) AS max_received
+    FROM pings WHERE ping_type = 'weekly' GROUP BY instance_id
+) latest ON latest.instance_id = p.instance_id AND latest.max_received = p.received_at
+WHERE p.ping_type = 'weekly';

+name: Telemetry canary
+
+# Daily deterministic regression check over the telemetry fleet — no AI in the loop,
+# so every filed issue is reproducible and arguable. Spec:
+# openspec/changes/add-opt-in-telemetry/specs/fleet-canary/spec.md
+#
+# Definitions (all tunable below):
+#   active     = instance with a weekly ping in the trailing 14 days
+#   eligible   = instance with >= 2 distinct weekly-ping weeks (Sybil gate:
+#                freshly minted UUIDs can't trip the canary)
+#   foreground = versions released in the trailing 14 days (from manifest.json),
+#                pooled — every merge ships, so single versions never accumulate n
+#   baseline   = everything older, pooled, excluding versions referenced by a
+#                still-open canary issue (an unfixed regression can't mask itself)
+#   cohort     = an instance belongs to the version of its most recent ping of ANY
+#                type (transition pings move an instance immediately)
+#   rate       = eligible instances with an error-transition ping in the trailing
+#                7 days / active eligible instances in the cohort
+# Issue gate: both cohorts n >= MIN_N and foreground rate >= RATE_MULTIPLE x baseline.
+# Dedup: open issue labelled telemetry-canary matching (suspect version, category).
+# The same run doubles as the row-growth abuse alarm.
+
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: "47 17 * * *" # daily, 17:47 UTC
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: write
+
+env:
+  MIN_N: 10
+  RATE_MULTIPLE: 3
+  MAX_TOTAL_ROWS: 1000000
+  MAX_NEW_INSTANCES_PER_DAY: 500
+
+jobs:
+  canary:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Run checks
+        env:
+          DB_URL: ${{ secrets.TELEMETRY_SUPABASE_DB_URL }}
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          if [ -z "$DB_URL" ]; then
+            echo "::error::TELEMETRY_SUPABASE_DB_URL secret not configured."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # ---- Growth alarm (abuse detection; loud failure, not an issue) ----
+          read -r TOTAL_ROWS NEW_INSTANCES <<< "$(psql "$DB_URL" -At -F' ' -c "
+            SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pings),
+                   (SELECT count(DISTINCT instance_id) FROM pings
+                    WHERE received_at > now() - interval '1 day'
+                      AND instance_id NOT IN (
+                        SELECT DISTINCT instance_id FROM pings
+                        WHERE received_at <= now() - interval '1 day'));")"
+          echo "Total rows: $TOTAL_ROWS; new instances last 24h: $NEW_INSTANCES"
+          if [ "$TOTAL_ROWS" -gt "$MAX_TOTAL_ROWS" ] || [ "$NEW_INSTANCES" -gt "$MAX_NEW_INSTANCES_PER_DAY" ]; then
+            echo "::error::Telemetry growth alarm: rows=$TOTAL_ROWS new_instances_24h=$NEW_INSTANCES exceed bounds."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # ---- Foreground versions: released in the trailing 14 days, per manifest ----
+          CUTOFF=$(date -u -d '14 days ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
+          FOREGROUND=$(jq -r --arg cutoff "$CUTOFF" \
+            '.[0].versions[] | select(.timestamp > $cutoff) | .version' manifest.json | sort -u)
+          if [ -z "$FOREGROUND" ]; then
+            echo "No versions released in the trailing 14 days; canary is structurally silent today."
+            exit 0
+          fi
+          FG_SQL=$(echo "$FOREGROUND" | sed "s/.*/'&'/" | paste -sd, -)
+          echo "Foreground versions: $(echo "$FOREGROUND" | paste -sd' ' -)"
+
+          # ---- Baseline exclusions: versions named in open canary issues ----
+          EXCLUDED=$(gh issue list --label telemetry-canary --state open --json title \
+            --jq '.[].title | capture("v(?<v>[0-9.]+)").v' 2>/dev/null | sort -u || true)
+          EX_SQL="''"
+          [ -n "$EXCLUDED" ] && EX_SQL=$(echo "$EXCLUDED" | sed "s/.*/'&'/" | paste -sd, -)
+          echo "Baseline exclusions: ${EXCLUDED:-none}"
+
+          # ---- Cohort rates per category ----
+          QUERY="
+            WITH eligible AS (
+              SELECT instance_id FROM pings WHERE ping_type='weekly'
+              GROUP BY instance_id HAVING count(DISTINCT week) >= 2
+            ),
+            cohort AS (
+              SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.instance_id) p.instance_id, p.plugin_version
+              FROM pings p JOIN eligible e USING (instance_id)
+              WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pings w WHERE w.instance_id = p.instance_id
+                            AND w.ping_type='weekly' AND w.received_at > now() - interval '14 days')
+              ORDER BY p.instance_id, p.received_at DESC
+            ),
+            grouped AS (
+              SELECT instance_id,
+                     CASE WHEN plugin_version IN ($FG_SQL) THEN 'fg'
+                          WHEN plugin_version IN ($EX_SQL) THEN 'excluded'
+                          ELSE 'bg' END AS pool
+              FROM cohort
+            ),
+            tr AS (
+              SELECT DISTINCT t.instance_id, cat.category,
+                     CASE WHEN t.plugin_version IN ($FG_SQL) THEN 'fg'
+                          WHEN t.plugin_version IN ($EX_SQL) THEN 'excluded'
+                          ELSE 'bg' END AS pool,

+              FROM pings t

+              LATERAL (VALUES ('cloudflare_403'),('auth_failure'),('tmdb_lookup'),('jellyseerr_error'),('other')) AS cat(category)
+              WHERE t.ping_type='error_transition'
+                AND t.received_at > now() - interval '7 days'
+                AND (t.errors->'state'->>cat.category)::boolean
+            )
+            SELECT json_build_object(
+              'fg_n',  (SELECT count(*) FROM grouped WHERE pool='fg'),
+              'bg_n',  (SELECT count(*) FROM grouped WHERE pool='bg'),
+              'categories', (
+                 SELECT coalesce(json_object_agg(category, json_build_object(
+                   'fg_hits', fg_hits, 'bg_hits', bg_hits, 'suspects', suspects)), '{}'::json)
+                 FROM (
+                   SELECT category,
+                          count(DISTINCT instance_id) FILTER (WHERE pool='fg') AS fg_hits,
+                          count(DISTINCT instance_id) FILTER (WHERE pool='bg') AS bg_hits,
+                          (SELECT json_object_agg(v, c) FROM (
+                             SELECT plugin_version v, count(DISTINCT instance_id) c FROM tr t2
+                             WHERE t2.category = tr.category AND t2.pool='fg'
+                             GROUP BY plugin_version ORDER BY c DESC) s) AS suspects
+                   FROM tr GROUP BY category) per_cat
+              ));"
+          RESULT=$(psql "$DB_URL" -At -c "$QUERY")
+          echo "$RESULT" | jq .
+
+          FG_N=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq '.fg_n')
+          BG_N=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq '.bg_n')
+          if [ "$FG_N" -lt "$MIN_N" ] || [ "$BG_N" -lt "$MIN_N" ]; then
+            echo "Below n gate (fg=$FG_N, bg=$BG_N, need >= $MIN_N each). Silence is correct behaviour."

+          fi

+          # ---- Gate + file per category ----
+          for CAT in $(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.categories | keys[]'); do

+            [ "$TRIPPED" != "true" ] && continue

+            SUSPECT=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r ".categories[\"$CAT\"].suspects | to_entries | max_by(.value) | .key")
+            TITLE="Telemetry canary: $CAT regression in v$SUSPECT"
+
+            if gh issue list --label telemetry-canary --state open --search "\"$TITLE\" in:title" --json number --jq 'length' | grep -qv '^0$'; then

+              continue
+            fi
+
+            EVIDENCE=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r ".categories[\"$CAT\"].suspects | to_entries | map(\"| \(.key) | \(.value) |\") | join(\"\n\")")
+            gh issue create --label telemetry-canary \

No AI involved; the query below reproduces it.\n\n**Category:** %s\n**Foreground** (versions released in trailing 14 days, pooled): %s of %s active eligible instances hit a %s error-transition in the trailing 7 days.\n**Baseline** (older versions pooled, exclusions applied): %s of %s.\n\n**Per-version evidence (foreground):**\n\n| version | instances |\n|---|---|\n%s\n\nThresholds: n >= %s both cohorts, rate multiple >= %sx.\nQuery: .github/workflows/telemetry-canary.yml\n' "$CAT" "$FG_HITS" "$FG_N" "$CAT" "$BG_HITS" "$BG_N" "$EVIDENCE" "$MIN_N" "$RATE_MULTIPLE")"
+            echo "Filed: $TITLE"
+          done

+-- Telemetry storage: one table, RLS deny-all, ingest happens only through the
+-- /ingest edge function (service role). See openspec/changes/add-opt-in-telemetry.
+
+create table if not exists public.pings (
+    id bigint generated always as identity primary key,
+    received_at timestamptz not null default now(),
+    -- Computed by the ingest function from UTC arrival time (a generated column
+    -- over timestamptz is non-immutable and fails; client clocks drift).
+    week date not null,
+    instance_id uuid not null,
+    schema_version int not null,
+    plugin_version text not null,
+    jellyfin_version text not null,
+    ping_type text not null check (ping_type in ('weekly', 'error_transition')),
+    features jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
+    buckets jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
+    errors jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb
+);
+
+-- One weekly row per instance per week; the ingest function merges counters on
+-- conflict so a duplicate send can never destroy a window's counts.
+create unique index if not exists pings_weekly_instance_week
+    on public.pings (instance_id, week)
+    where ping_type = 'weekly';
+
+create index if not exists pings_instance_received on public.pings (instance_id, received_at desc);
+create index if not exists pings_type_received on public.pings (ping_type, received_at desc);
+
+-- Deny-all: the anon key shipped in the plugin cannot read or write this table.
+-- The edge function uses the service role internally after validating.
+alter table public.pings enable row level security;
+
+-- Active installs by version: latest weekly ping per instance.
+create or replace view public.latest_per_instance as
+select distinct on (instance_id)
+    instance_id, received_at, week, plugin_version, jellyfin_version, features, buckets, errors
+from public.pings
+where ping_type = 'weekly'
+order by instance_id, received_at desc;

+-- Telemetry storage on Cloudflare D1 (SQLite). The database is reachable ONLY
+-- through the ingest Worker and scoped API tokens; there is no direct client
+-- access path, which is what RLS provided in the abandoned Supabase design.
+-- See openspec/changes/add-opt-in-telemetry/specs/telemetry-backend.
+
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pings (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+    received_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now')),
+    -- Computed by the Worker from UTC arrival time (client clocks drift).
+    week TEXT NOT NULL,
+    instance_id TEXT NOT NULL,
+    schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
+    plugin_version TEXT NOT NULL,
+    jellyfin_version TEXT NOT NULL,
+    ping_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (ping_type IN ('weekly', 'error_transition')),
+    features TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+    buckets TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
+    errors TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
+);
+
+-- One weekly row per instance per week; the Worker merges counters on conflict
+-- so a duplicate send can never destroy a window's counts.
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_weekly_instance_week
+    ON pings (instance_id, week) WHERE ping_type = 'weekly';
+
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_instance_received ON pings (instance_id, received_at DESC);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pings_type_received ON pings (ping_type, received_at DESC);
+
+-- Active installs by version: latest weekly ping per instance.
+CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS latest_per_instance AS
+SELECT p.instance_id, p.received_at, p.week, p.plugin_version, p.jellyfin_version,
+       p.features, p.buckets, p.errors
+FROM pings p
+JOIN (
+    SELECT instance_id, MAX(received_at) AS max_received
+    FROM pings WHERE ping_type = 'weekly' GROUP BY instance_id
+) latest ON latest.instance_id = p.instance_id AND latest.max_received = p.received_at
+WHERE p.ping_type = 'weekly';
